contradictions.title: No canonical P/S/T equivalence established
contradictions.description: The claim that P/S/T has a canonical implementation remains unsupported because EXP-001 found no canonical equivalence across the recorded variants.
contradictions.observed_behavior: Recorded variants did not establish canonical equivalence.
contradictions.expected_behavior: A canonical implementation claim would require reproducible equivalence evidence.
contradictions.resolution_notes: Not resolved. Preserve as an explicit promotion blocker.

contradictions.title: LSTM implementation claim contradicted by source inspection
contradictions.description: The historical claim that the hamidcognition-realtime predictor is an LSTM implementation was contradicted by direct source inspection, which found LinearRegression.
contradictions.observed_behavior: Implementation contains LinearRegression rather than an LSTM model.
contradictions.expected_behavior: A claim of LSTM implementation would require an actual LSTM implementation in the inspected source.
contradictions.resolution_notes: Claim falsified by direct source inspection. This record remains for provenance and contradiction history.

contradictions.title: EUR/USD predictor predictive-skill claim falsified
contradictions.description: The historical claim that the audited EUR/USD predictor demonstrated out-of-sample predictive skill was tested against two disjoint real Yahoo Finance 5-minute snapshots under the pre-registered EXP-004 walk-forward gate and failed decisively.
contradictions.observed_behavior: At the primary +5 minute horizon, predictor accuracy was 0.2166 versus 0.5075 majority baseline in snapshot A and 0.2553 versus 0.4983 majority baseline in snapshot B. Accuracy deltas were -0.2909 and -0.2430; cost-aware returns were -0.2792 and -0.3113. Bootstrap 95% CIs for the accuracy deltas excluded zero in both snapshots, and paired sign-flip permutation p-values were 0.000999 in both.
contradictions.expected_behavior: A predictive-skill claim would require the audited predictor to beat the declared primary baseline on the frozen out-of-sample gate across independent real-data snapshots without leakage.
contradictions.resolution_notes: EXP-004 executed real chronological walk-forward evaluation with future_features_used=false, test_tuning=false, disjoint source snapshots, and SHA-256 fingerprints. The audited predictor failed the primary gate in both snapshots. Do not promote the historical predictive-skill claim. Any future predictor must be treated as a new claim with a new pre-registration and independent evidence package.
